s = s.replace(\"window.addEventListener('pagehide', event => { if ("'!event.persisted) cleanup(); }, options);", "window.addEventListener('"'pagehide', event => { pause(); if ("'!event.persisted) cleanup(); }, options);'"\\n  window.addEventListener('pageshow', syncMedia, options);\")

Preserve-mode authoring; two original sections, copy, destinations, IDs, analytics, details behavior, tokens and original control rules retained.

Selected R1/R2: text-only load entrances (0/80/160ms delay) and once-only work reveals (0/100ms); 600ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), opacity .75→1, translateY 14px→0. Controls and their ancestors remain static; normal HTML stays visible without initialization.

Selected R3/R4: supplied scene.webm and poster.svg; verified local fixture rights in assets/rights.json. In-flow 2.12:1 desktop / 16:10 mobile frame; cover at 65% 50%, copy on paper. No optional loop fade selected without runtime evidence.

Authored breakpoint: 600px; wide gutters at 1100px. Browser/runtime behavior, layout at 375/768/1440 and short landscape, keyboard/touch behavior, codec playback, loop seams, failure paths and live preference changes are unverified; central observer owns qualification. No browser, server, external service, installation, build or independent review run.
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re, shutil, subprocess
class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, text):
        super().__init__(); self.text=[]; self.ids=[]; self.links=[]; self.sections=[]; self.skip=None; self.feed(text)
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs)
        if tag in ('style','script'): self.skip=tag
        if 'id' in attrs: self.ids.append(attrs['id'])
        if tag=='a': self.links.append(attrs.get('href'))
        if tag=='section': self.sections.append(attrs.get('id'))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag==self.skip: self.skip=None
    def handle_data(self, text):
        if not self.skip and text.strip(): self.text.append(text.strip())
before=Path('/tmp/field-notes-before.html').read_text(); after=Path('index.html').read_text()
a,b=Page(before),Page(after)
assert a.text==b.text, 'Copy changed'
assert a.ids==b.ids, 'IDs changed'
assert a.links==b.links, 'Destinations changed'
assert a.sections==b.sections==['intro','work'], 'Sections changed'
original_script=re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',before,re.S)[0]
assert original_script==re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',after,re.S)[0], 'Original behavior script changed'
original_rules=re.findall(r'["'^{}]+'"\\{["'^{}]*'"\\}',re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>',before,re.S)[1])
assert all(rule in after for rule in original_rules), 'Original brand/control rule changed'
for asset in ('scene.webm','poster.svg','rights.json'): assert Path('assets',asset).is_file()
node=shutil.which('node')
if node:
    for script in re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',after,re.S):
        subprocess.run([node,'--check'],input=script,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
    syntax='Inline JavaScript syntax passed (existing node --check).'
else: syntax='JavaScript syntax not checked: node unavailable.'
print('PASS: exact copy, IDs, destinations, two sections, original script, original CSS rules, local asset presence.')
print(syntax)
with Path('NOTES.md').open('a') as notes:
    notes.write('\\nSource check passed: exact original copy, IDs, destinations, sections, behavior script and CSS rules; asset presence. '+syntax+'\\n')
PY"
